senses.gloss:
फञ्जिका f. (-का)
 1. A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
 2. A species of
Hedysarum, (H. alhagi.)
 E. भञ्ज् to break, (disease,) aff. ण्वुल्, and
the radical initial changed to फ ।

फञ्जिपुत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, (Talvinia cucullata.)
 E. फञ्जि as above, and
पुत्रिका infant. “उन्दुरकानि” ।
